sources.summary: Dezeen Showroom: designer Sebastian Herkner worked with Italian heating brand Tubes to create Terre, the company's first radiator made from terracotta. Taking its name from the Italian word for "earth", Terre is made from the clay of the Impruneta quarry in Tuscany, providing a warm, rustic contrast to the usual metal character of radiators.
